hook.en: Careers in research are rarely ended by a failed study. They end with a fabricated number, a copied paragraph or a name left off a paper. Integrity is not a lecture from the ethics office: it is the daily habit that makes every other number in your work believable.
hook.ur: Research ke career shayad hi kisi nakam study se khatam hote hain. Woh gharay hue number, copy kiye hue paragraph ya paper se hataye gaye naam se khatam hote hain. Integrity ethics ke daftar ka lecture nahi: yeh roz ki aadat hai jo aap ke kaam ke har doosre number ko qabil-e-yaqeen banati hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll name the core misconduct types (fabrication, falsification, plagiarism), apply the ICMJE authorship criteria, recognise questionable research practices, handle conflicts of interest, and know what to do if you see a problem.
goal.ur: End tak aap misconduct ki bunyadi qismein (fabrication, falsification, plagiarism) batayenge, ICMJE musannifi ke criteria lagu karenge, shak wale research amal pehchanenge, mufaadat ke takrao sambhalenge, aur jaanenge masla dikhe to kya karna hai.

text.en: **Research misconduct** is usually defined as **fabrication** (making up data), **falsification** (changing data, images or methods so the record is wrong) and **plagiarism** (using others' ideas or words without credit). A wider set of **questionable research practices** is far more common: selective reporting, p-hacking, undeclared conflicts of interest, gift or ghost authorship and salami-slicing one study into many thin papers. The **ICMJE** says an author must make a substantial contribution, help draft or revise the work, approve the final version and agree to be accountable for it, and all four are needed.
text.ur: **Research misconduct** aam taur par **fabrication** (data gharna), **falsification** (data, tasveerein ya tareeqe badalna taake record ghalat ho) aur **plagiarism** (doosron ke khayal ya alfaaz bina credit istemal karna) kehlata hai. **Shak wale research amal** ka wasi set kahin zyada aam hai: chun-chun kar report karna, p-hacking, na bataye gaye mufaadat ke takrao, tohfe ya chhupi musannifi, aur ek study ko kai patle papers mein baantna. **ICMJE** kehta hai ke musannif ko ahem hissa dalna, kaam ka draft ya nazar-e-saani mein madad karna, aakhri versiyon manzoor karna aur is ki zimmedari lena hoga, aur chaaron zaroori hain.

text.en: Think of **a bank ledger**. Every entry must be real, traceable and signed by the person responsible. One invented entry, even a small one, makes the whole book untrustworthy, and the damage reaches colleagues who relied on it. Integrity keeps the ledger of science honest for everyone who uses it.
text.ur: **Bank ka khata** sochein. Har indraj asal, tarteeb se dhoondha ja sakne wala aur zimmedar shakhs ka dastakhat shuda hona chahiye. Ek gharha hua indraj, chhota bhi, poori kitab ko na-qabil-e-aitbaar bana deta hai, aur nuqsan un saathiyon tak pohanchta hai jinhon ne us par bharosa kiya. Integrity science ke khate ko un sab ke liye imaandar rakhti hai jo isay istemal karte hain.

rows.en: Report only what was collected, even if it is disappointing
rows.ur: Sirf wohi report karein jo jama hua, chahe mayoos kun ho

rows.en: Dropping inconvenient values, editing images or changing records without a documented reason
rows.ur: Na-pasandeeda values hatana, tasveerein badalna ya wajah likhe baghair record badalna

rows.en: Keep raw data, document every exclusion with a rule fixed beforehand
rows.ur: Raw data rakhein, har exclusion ko pehle se tay shuda qaide ke saath likhein

rows.en: Copying text or ideas, or reusing your own published text without saying so
rows.ur: Text ya khayal copy karna, ya apna shaya shuda text bina bataye dobara istemal karna

rows.en: Quote, cite and paraphrase honestly; reference your earlier work
rows.ur: Hawala dein, aur imaandari se paraphrase karein; apne pehle kaam ka hawala dein

rows.en: Adding a senior who did nothing, or leaving off someone who did the work
rows.ur: Aise senior ko jorna jis ne kuch nahi kiya, ya kaam karne wale ko chhor dena

rows.en: Use the ICMJE criteria and agree authorship early in writing
rows.ur: ICMJE criteria istemal karein aur musannifi jaldi likh kar tay karein
Na bataye gaye mufaadat ke takrao

rows.en: A company funds the study or pays the author and nobody is told
rows.ur: Company study ki funding kare ya musannif ko paise de aur kisi ko na bataya jaye

rows.en: Declare funding, fees, equipment and relationships in the paper
rows.ur: Funding, fees, aala aur rishte paper mein batayein

question.en: A junior researcher collected most of the data and wrote the first draft. A senior professor only provided the clinic. Who qualifies as an author under ICMJE?
question.ur: Ek junior muhaqqiq ne zyada tar data jama kiya aur pehla draft likha. Ek senior professor ne sirf clinic diya. ICMJE ke tahet musannif kaun banta hai?

text.en: Nobody, since the data belong to the clinic
text.ur: Koi nahi, kyunke data clinic ka hai

feedback.en: The person who did the work is an author.

text.ur: Professor, senior hone ki wajah se

text.en: The junior researcher; the professor should be thanked in the acknowledgements unless they also meet all four criteria
text.ur: Junior muhaqqiq; professor ka shukriya acknowledgements mein hona chahiye jab tak woh chaaron criteria poore na karein

feedback.en: Yes — providing a clinic or funding alone does not make someone an author.
feedback.ur: Haan — sirf clinic ya funding dena kisi ko musannif nahi banata.

question.en: In an analysis, three participants' values look like extreme outliers and removing them makes the result significant. What is the honest approach?
question.ur: Tajziye mein teen shirkat karne walon ki values intehai outliers lagti hain aur unhein hata kar nateeja significant ho jata hai. Imaandar tareeqa kya hai?

text.en: Keep only the analysis that gives p below 0.05
text.ur: Sirf woh tajziya rakhein jo p ko 0.05 se neeche de

feedback.ur: Yeh chun-chun kar report karna hai.

text.en: Remove them quietly because they hurt the result
text.ur: Chupke se hata dein kyunke woh nateeje ko nuqsan dete hain

text.en: Check them against the original records, report the analysis with and without them, and explain any exclusion with a rule decided beforehand
text.ur: Unhein asal records se milayein, unhein rakh kar aur hata kar tajziya report karein, aur pehle se tay shuda qaide ke saath koi exclusion samjhayein

feedback.ur: Haan — shaffafiyat kaam ko mehfooz rakhti hai.

question.en: You notice that a colleague's figure appears to be reused in two different papers. What should you do?
question.ur: Aap dekhte hain ke saathi ka figure do mukhtalif papers mein dobara istemal hua lagta hai. Aap ko kya karna chahiye?

text.en: Raise it privately and factually with the colleague or your supervisor, and use the institution's research integrity process if concerns remain
text.ur: Nijji aur haqaiq par mabni taur par saathi ya apne supervisor se baat karein, aur fikr baqi rahe to idare ka research integrity ka amal istemal karein

feedback.en: Yes — start with facts and proper channels, not accusation.
feedback.ur: Haan — ilzam nahi, haqaiq aur sahi raaston se shuru karein.

text.en: Ignore it, because it is not your business
text.ur: Nazar-andaaz karein, yeh aap ka kaam nahi

text.en: Post it on social media to shame them
text.ur: Sharminda karne ke liye social media par post karein

feedback.en: That is unfair and may be wrong.
feedback.ur: Yeh na-munsifana hai aur ghalat ho sakta hai.

text.en: **Thinking "everyone does it" or "it is only a small change".** Small shortcuts add up and usually grow. A single deleted value or a copied paragraph, once discovered, can end a career, and retractions harm co-authors and patients who relied on the findings. Also, do not wait until the paper is accepted to sort out authorship, and never agree to put your name on work you cannot defend.
text.ur: **Yeh sochna ke "sab karte hain" ya "yeh sirf chhoti tabdeeli hai".** Chhote shortcuts jama hote hain aur aam taur par barhte hain. Ek hatayi hui value ya copy kiya hua paragraph, pakde jane par, career khatam kar sakta hai, aur retractions un saathi musannifon aur mareezon ko nuqsan dete hain jinhon ne findings par bharosa kiya. Musannifi ka faisla paper qabool hone tak na taalen, aur aise kaam par apna naam kabhi na dein jis ka aap difa na kar saken.

text.en: **Build integrity into the routine.** Keep a lab or study notebook with dates, never overwrite raw data, write your analysis plan before looking at results, save every version of your code or spreadsheet, and write a contribution statement for each author at the start. These habits protect you if anyone ever asks "how do you know?"
text.ur: **Integrity ko routine mein shamil karein.** Tareekhon ke saath notebook rakhein, raw data par kabhi na likhein, nateeje dekhne se pehle tajziye ka plan likhein, apne code ya spreadsheet ka har version mehfooz rakhein, aur shuru mein har musannif ke hissay ka bayan likhein. Yeh aadatein aap ko mehfooz rakhti hain agar kabhi koi poochhe "aap ko kaise pata?"

question.en: Why is "honest error" treated differently from misconduct?
question.ur: "Imaandar ghalti" ko misconduct se mukhtalif kyun samjha jata hai?

answer.en: Honest error is an unintentional mistake: a wrong formula, a mislabelled column. Science is full of them, and the right response is to correct the record quickly, with a correction or retraction if needed, without blame. Misconduct is intentional or reckless deception. The line is drawn by intent and by how errors are handled: people who admit and fix mistakes are trusted, and those who hide them are not.
answer.ur: Imaandar ghalti ghair iradi hoti hai: ghalat formula, ghalat label wala column. Science mein yeh bohat hoti hain, aur sahi jawab record ko jaldi theek karna hai, zaroorat ho to correction ya retraction ke saath, bina ilzam. Misconduct jaan boojh kar ya laaparwai se kiya gaya dhoka hai. Lakeer irade se aur is se kheenchi jati hai ke ghaltiyan kaise sambhali gayin: jo log ghaltiyan maan kar theek karte hain un par bharosa hota hai, aur jo chhupate hain un par nahi.

beats.patient: A student's trial shows no difference between two exercise programmes. Her supervisor suggests she "tidy up" the data by removing the 6 patients who attended fewer than 4 sessions, which would create a significant difference, and to add the head of department as an author.
beats.assessment: Dropping patients after seeing the result is selective exclusion, and the head of department has not met the authorship criteria.
beats.treatment: She politely explains that she will report an intention-to-treat analysis and a per-protocol analysis in advance of looking at results, and lists contributions for authorship in writing; the head of department is thanked in the acknowledgements.
beats.reassess: Her paper reports an honest null result and is accepted, and her supervisor learns from the discussion.

text.en: **Integrity protects patients.** Fabricated or manipulated results can lead clinicians to use ineffective or harmful treatments. If you see unsafe data or signs of misconduct, report it through your institution's integrity process or a senior person you trust. Whistleblowers should be protected; if you worry about consequences, seek advice from an ombudsperson or a professional body first.
text.ur: **Integrity mareezon ko mehfooz rakhti hai.** Gharay ya badle hue nateeje clinicians ko be-asar ya nuqsandeh ilaaj istemal karwa sakte hain. Agar aap ghair mehfooz data ya misconduct ki nishaniyan dekhein to apne idare ke integrity ke amal ya kisi bharosemand senior shakhs ke zariye report karein. Khabar dene walon ko mehfooz hona chahiye; nataij ka khauf ho to pehle ombudsperson ya peshawarana idare se mashwara lein.

text.en: The ICMJE Recommendations define authorship by four criteria that all must be met: substantial contributions to the work, drafting or critically revising it, final approval of the version to be published, and agreement to be accountable for all aspects of the work. The Singapore Statement on Research Integrity sets out four principles (honesty, accountability, professional courtesy and fairness, and good stewardship) and fourteen responsibilities for researchers, including reporting irresponsible research practices and disclosing conflicts of interest.
text.ur: ICMJE sifarishat musannifi ko chaar criteria se tay karti hain jo sab poore hone chahiye: kaam mein ahem hissa, draft ya tanqeedi nazar-e-saani, shaya hone wale version ki aakhri manzoori, aur kaam ke har pehlu ki zimmedari ka ittefaq. Singapore Statement on Research Integrity chaar usool (imaandari, jawabdehi, peshawarana shaistagi aur insaaf, aur achhi nigehbani) aur muhaqqiqon ke chaudah farayez batata hai, jin mein na-zimmedarana research amal ki report aur mufaadat ke takrao ka elaan shamil hain.

text.en: **Real, Traceable, Credited, Declared.** Data are real, steps are traceable, work is credited fairly and conflicts are declared.
text.ur: **Asal, Dhoondhne ke qabil, Credit, Elaan.** Data asal, qadam dhoondhne ke qabil, kaam ko munsifana credit aur mufaadat ke takrao ka elaan.

summary.en: Fabrication, falsification and plagiarism are misconduct; selective reporting and unfair authorship are more common but still harm trust.
summary.ur: Fabrication, falsification aur plagiarism misconduct hain; chun-chun kar report karna aur na-munsifana musannifi zyada aam hain lekin phir bhi bharosa nuqsan deti hain.

summary.en: Authorship needs all four ICMJE criteria; agree it early in writing and declare conflicts of interest.
summary.ur: Musannifi ko ICMJE ke chaaron criteria chahiye; jaldi likh kar tay karein aur mufaadat ke takrao ka elaan karein.

summary.en: Admit and correct honest errors quickly; report real concerns through proper channels.
summary.ur: Imaandar ghaltiyan maan kar jaldi theek karein; asal fikron ki report sahi raaston se karein.

front.en: What are the three core types of research misconduct?
front.ur: Research misconduct ki teen bunyadi qismein?

front.en: What do the ICMJE authorship criteria require?
front.ur: ICMJE musannifi ke criteria kya maangte hain?

back.en: Substantial contribution, drafting or revising, final approval and accountability, all four.
back.ur: Ahem hissa, draft ya nazar-e-saani, aakhri manzoori aur zimmedari, chaaron.

back.en: Naming someone as author who did not meet the criteria.
back.ur: Aise shakhs ko musannif likhna jis ne criteria poore nahi kiye.

front.en: What is the right response to an honest error?
front.ur: Imaandar ghalti ka sahi jawab kya hai?

back.en: Correct the record quickly and openly.
back.ur: Record ko jaldi aur khule taur par theek karna.

note.ur: Shirkat karne walon ki hifazat aur imaandar tarz-e-amal.
